note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). All five screens are portal screens in the lab tenant (environment DEV); run them in the order listed so the run history and the digest exist.
prepare: # owner signs in: separate browser profiles for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com, SharePoint), alex.demo and taylor.demo (Outlook on the web). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1-4): SharePoint site IT Helpdesk with list IT Requests (Category, Priority, Status, DueDate); solution IT Requests (ITRequests) with the flows 'IT request intake' and 'IT requests daily digest', both turned on

# owner (demo.md Setup 5): as alex.demo add the three items: Laptop won't boot before a client demo (Hardware, High), New monitor for the Lisbon office (Hardware, Normal), [TEST] please ignore (Software, Normal); wait 5-10 minutes for the polling trigger
# owner (demo.md Setup 7): run 'IT requests daily digest' once with Test > Manually so there is a run and an email to film

screens.name: list
steps: Open the IT Helpdesk site and select the list 'IT Requests'
Make sure the view shows Title, Category, Priority, Status, Due date and Created by
Point at the three rows by Alex Demo: the High priority laptop item, the Normal monitor item and '[TEST] please ignore'
Pause on the full list for three seconds
mask: tenant name in the address bar
tenant name in the SharePoint header and suite bar
any user e-mail address that is not a lab user

screens.name: designer
steps: Select environment DEV in the top bar
Open Solutions > IT Requests
Open the cloud flow 'IT request intake' (new designer)

Scroll slowly from the trigger 'When an IT request is created' down through Initialize SLA hours, Due date, the condition 'Is high priority' (Alert on-call engineer in the True branch), Mark as triaged and Acknowledge requester
Pause with all six steps visible
mask: environment name and ID in the address bar
tenant name in the top bar and account menu
site URL inside the trigger card

screens.name: run-high
steps: Open the flow 'IT request intake' and its 28-day run history
Open the successful run that belongs to 'Laptop won't boot before a client demo'
Show every action green
Expand 'Alert on-call engineer' and show the subject 'HIGH priority IT request #<id>: Laptop won't boot before a client demo' and Importance High
Second capture, same scene: open the SharePoint item and show Status Triaged and the Due date four hours after creation
mask: environment ID in the address bar
mailbox addresses that are not lab users
site URL in the action inputs

screens.name: all-runs-skipped
steps: Open the details page of 'IT request intake'
In the run history switch the filter to 'All runs' (trigger checks included)
Point at the skipped trigger check at the time the '[TEST] please ignore' item was created and show that no run exists for it
If no skipped entry is listed, show the history with only the two real runs and say so
mask: environment ID in the address bar

screens.name: digest
steps: Open the inbox of Taylor Demo (service desk mailbox)
Open the mail 'IT requests: N open, M overdue'
Scroll to the HTML table with ID, Title, Priority and Due
Alternative if the mail is not there: open the run details of 'IT requests daily digest' and expand the Filter array output
mask: real e-mail addresses and tenant domain in the header and the account menu
tenant name in the suite bar

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn off both flows (the scheduled one mails every weekday); delete the [TEST] item and the sample items if the list is not reused by episode 2
